reviewNotes: Initial packet has systematic matched transforms and repeated passages/propositions. Those are not independent validation cases.

Six minimal named-study/record descriptions were provisionally content-positive because the rubric explicitly permits attributable methods/findings and descriptions of named formal records. They are flagged for pre-provider adjudication rather than forced into generic-negative labels.
Three plain concise fact assertions were provisionally negative but flagged because descriptive-reference boundaries need explicit operational rules.

Do not let promotional surroundings alone turn a retained dated announcement or particular named-record finding into a content-negative; judge the target proposition. Conversely content-positive never means true, authoritative or independent.
